mechanism: Posaconazole is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase piperacillin-tazobactam levels and alter beta-lactam pharmacokinetics, with potential for increased toxicity in renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function closely and watch for signs of beta-lactam toxicity; dose adjustment of piperacillin-tazobactam may be needed in renal impairment; no dose change typically required in normal renal function.
